description: Sends a charter trip request for one aircraft to the booking contact its owner named. Call it only after the person you are helping has asked to proceed, with their own name and email. Nothing is booked or held: the requester is emailed a link, the request is delivered only once they confirm it, and the booking contact then replies to them directly. If the owner set qualification questions, the first call answers needs_answers with the questions; ask the person each one and call again with their answers in the same order.

answers.description: Answers to the owner's qualification questions, in the order request_trip returned them.

date.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

email.description: The email address of the person asking. The confirmation link is sent here.

from.description: Departure airport identifier, ICAO or FAA, for example KTEB.

name.description: The full name of the person asking, as they gave it.

notes.description: Anything else the person wants the booking contact to know.

phone.description: Their phone number, if they want to be called.

return_date.description: Return date for a round trip, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one way.

tail.description: A U.S. registration mark such as N864BF. Case and hyphens are ignored.

to.description: Arrival airport identifier, ICAO or FAA, for example KMIA.

name: request_trip
title: Request a charter trip
